items.claim: average() divides by len(prices) without an empty guard, so it raises ZeroDivisionError for empty lists, which the docstring and PR description both say are common.
items.consequence: A newly created cart has prices == []. The summary panel calls average([]), which evaluates 0 / 0 and raises ZeroDivisionError, so the panel crashes instead of showing a value such as 0.0 or None.
